Members of kinds the S3 model has none of (byte, short, float, double, blob, intEnum) are absent from the shapes: they are removed from the params and their top-level element from the expected body (listed per case in `dropped`). Union members are PascalCase with the original name as xmlName. The rest are listed in `excluded` with the reason. The expected body is compared as an XML tree: element and attribute names, namespaces and text, white space between elements ignored.
